playstyle.role: Pet-based nuker / support hybrid: commands up to three floating AI pets (attack, heal, mezz/crowd-control) while nuking and debuffing, and provides top-tier nanoskill buffs to the team.
strengths: Three simultaneous pets: attacker (damage), healer (support), mezz (crowd control) for versatile combat
Second-best nanoskill buffs in the game (Mochams / Composite Infuses, +140 nanoskills, behind only Trader's +147)
Strong nuke and debuff kit (Mind Quake debuff line, Trader-like nano/skill debuffs)
Pets are persistent (no longer time-limited), so wrangles can be used to cast above self-cast level
Excellent solo capability once pets are up; good team utility (buffs, mezz, off-heals)
weaknesses: Low weapon skills (1HB, 2HE, Bow, Pistol are expensive) - weak personal weapon damage
Squishy: relies on pets to tank; caught without pets it is fragile
Pet management complexity (positioning, re-casting on death, over-equip / body pool concerns)
Ancient Knowledge AI perk pet effects are bugged / unreliable
playstyle.summary: The Meta-Physicist (profession 12) is Anarchy Online's cosmic pet-master: it summons an attack pet, heal pet, and mezz pet from the 'other side' and supplements them with nukes, debuffs, and the game's second-strongest nanoskill buffs. Play centers on keeping the right pets up, keeping them and the team healed, and controlling the fight with mezz and debuffs.
tips: Keep pets at the highest nanoline level you can self-cast (or wrangle up); re-summon promptly when a pet dies
Max the nano schools first - they gate which pets, nukes and buffs you can cast
Buff teammates with Mocham's Gifts and Composite Infuses; this is a large part of MP team value
Use the mezz pet for crowd control rather than trying to weapon-tank
Watch pet over-equipment/body pool when using outside buffs to cast pets above self-cast level

breed.reasoning: Nanomage has the highest Intelligence and Psychic, which most directly raise the nanoskills the MP lives on (MM/BM/MC/TS/PM/SI). This lets it cast higher-tier attack pets, nukes and buffs sooner and with less IP, and gives the largest nano pool for sustained casting. The Funcom-forums MP guide states Nanomage is the optimal choice: 'Nanomage have most Int and Psy... Int ability will boost your nano skills most' and 'You will need a lot of MC and TS all the time 1-220'.

alternatives.note: Balanced all-rounder with no hard caps; easier, more forgiving IP spread and better HP/AC than Nanomage. Solid, safer pick if you dislike the Nanomage fragility.

Most HP and best melee/Body Dev, but low base nano pool and lower Int/Psy make nanoskills more IP-hungry; nano pool is 'especially important for the Atrox breed' per AOWiki. Chosen mainly for survivability/froob play, not for peak casting.
Best evades and highest run speed for kiting/positioning, but lower Int/Psy than Nanomage/Solitus; a niche survivability pick, not the casting optimum.

perks.name: Soothing Spirit
perks.effect: Premier MP heal line: up to ~50% bonus to heal-pet healing at max, plus special actions Spirit of Blessing (team heal up to ~1,300 HP) and Spirit of Purity (team nano refill up to ~1,300 nano). Also changes the heal pet's appearance.
perks.recommendedAtLevel: Start at 30; max first as IP/levels allow

perks.name: Channel Rage
perks.effect: Buffs the attack pet: +30 AddAllOff and +300 to all damage types at max; also gives the MP ~210 HP and assorted resistances. Overall value is debated in the community.

perks.name: Starfall
perks.effect: Self offense/utility: +400 max nano and +160 health, plus a 4-step damage special-action chain (Dazzle with Lights, Combust, Thermal Detonation, Supernova) used in sequence.

perks.name: Blunt Mastery
perks.line: Blunt Mastery (max rank 4 at level 80, shared with Enforcer)
perks.effect: +45 to 1-Hand Blunt skill and grants Quick Bash direct-damage special action; only useful for a 1HB-weapon MP.

perks.name: Ranger
perks.effect: +75 Bow and +38 Bow Special Attack, plus Clearshot and Popshot specials; only for a bow-using MP.

perks.name: Ancient Knowledge
perks.effect: Intended to buff pets, but pet effects are bugged/non-functional; generally not recommended as a priority.

perks.name: Ego Strike / Super-Ego Strike
perks.effect: Offensive damage proc perks that fire during combat (mind/ego damage). LEProcMetaPhysicistEgoStrike / LEProcMetaPhysicistSuperEgoStrike in local PerkHash enum.
perks.recommendedAtLevel: Slot on an offensive proc setup

perks.name: Mind Wail
perks.effect: Offensive AoE-style mind proc. LEProcMetaPhysicistMindWail in enum.

perks.name: Anticipated Evasion
perks.effect: Defensive proc that raises evasion when it fires. LEProcMetaPhysicistAnticipatedEvasion in enum.

perks.name: Regain Focus
perks.effect: Defensive/sustain proc (nano/focus recovery). LEProcMetaPhysicistRegainFocus in enum.

perks.name: Diffuse Rage
perks.effect: Defensive proc (damage/aggression reduction). LEProcMetaPhysicistDiffuseRage in enum.

perks.name: Economic Nanobot Use
perks.effect: Sustain proc reducing nano cost / restoring nano. LEProcMetaPhysicistEconomicNanobotUse in enum.

perks.name: Sow Doubt / Sow Despair / Thoughtful Means
perks.effect: Debuff/utility procs (LEProcMetaPhysicistSowDoubt, LEProcMetaPhysicistSowDespair, LEProcMetaPhysicistThoughtfulMeans in enum). Line assignment of these three not confirmed in fetched sources.

research.name: Foresight
research.effect: Int/Quantum-Physics scaling; grants proc perks Ego Strike (offense) and Anticipated Evasion (evasion).
research.note: Good all-round MP personal line: offense + defense procs.

research.name: Perseverances
research.effect: Health/defense scaling; grants Regain Focus, Mind Wail and Nanobot Contingent Arrest procs.
research.note: Survivability + an offensive Mind Wail proc.

research.name: Sympathy
research.effect: Nano-programming/Int scaling; grants Suppress Fury and Super-Ego Strike procs.
research.note: Nanoskill support plus a strong offensive Super-Ego Strike proc.

research.name: Spatial Awareness
research.effect: Evasion/Stamina scaling; grants Diffuse Rage and Economic Nanobot Use procs.

research.name: Angst
research.effect: Strength and nano-skill progression culminating in psychic abilities.

research.name: Jealousy
research.effect: Melee/exploit-weakness focus with nano-cost reduction and attack modifiers.
research.note: Lower priority for a caster MP.

research.name: Trauma
research.effect: Ranged/bow focus: Aimed Shot and Bow proficiency with initiative bonuses (to ~60 Bow at completion).

research.name: Personal Research (skill/perk unlocks)
research.effect: The seven MP lines above are all personal (not global): each is 10 levels with skill and perk-point requirements per tier, funded by redirecting a chosen % of XP.
research.note: All MP profession research lines are personal per AOWiki.

research.name: Global Research (all-profession)
research.effect: Shared cross-profession global lines (general bonuses) apply to MP as to any profession.
research.note: Not MP-specific; standard global picks apply.

Core nano school; heals and heal-pet casting - 'always max this skill'
Core nano school; nukes and pet casting - 'always keep maxed', heavily used 1-220
Core nano school; pets/summons and utility - 'always max this skill', needed all levels
Needed for buffs/mezz and debuffs - max when possible
Needed for buff casting - max when possible
Fuel for constant pet/nuke/buff casting; especially important at low levels and for Atrox
Faster cast/recast on pets, heals and nukes
Needed for many things (NCU, tradeskills, decks) - 'max this out'
Heal and nano kits, and implant install - 'max this out'

skillPriorities.skill: Dodge Ranged / Evade Close Combat / Duck Explosives
skillPriorities.why: Survivability while pets tank - keep high or max whenever possible
HP buffer; raise if you find yourself dying a lot (higher value for Atrox)
Expensive for MP and secondary to pets; only invest for a specific weapon plan (e.g. bow with Ranger/Trauma)
